notes: No API or awareness-monitor execution. Scores are overlaid by native-score-corrections.jsonl; correction validity/status overrides original events.

observed_mean is trial weighted. task_cluster_mean and contrasts are equal-original-task weighted; AgentHarm has 39 original clusters, other benchmarks 50.
Pairing uses original model/benchmark/setting/item/sample keys. Controls are reused across phrasings, not independent extra trials.
Intervals are normal-approximation descriptive 95%, unadjusted for multiple comparisons and conditional on frozen tasks/phrases; no confirmed causal belief uptake.
All-assigned bounds use [0,1] for unknown scores; contrast bounds use equal-task weighting. Pooled and lexical cells overlap.
AM primary harmful_action_classifier differs from released_original_score (keyword-gated blackmail). Missing hidden reasoning leaves that original metric unknown, not negative.
GSM8K is an independently baseline-solved selected subset; fresh no-edit draws are the reported controls.
